bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; prohibiting unproductive conservation lands from being considered benefited property under state drainage laws; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 103E.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[103E.026] UNPRODUCTIVE CONSERVATION LANDS ARE NOT BENEFITED BY DRAINAGE PROJECTS OR REPAIRS.

Notwithstanding any provision of this chapter to the contrary, any determination of benefits under this chapter, whether for a drainage project or for repairing a drainage system, must not include a determination that property is benefited if the property is subject to a conservation easement.
